transcript: I put the modern green utopia first because it seemed like it had the best balance between security and sustainability and just the everyday quality of life. In second place, I put the religious utopia because I think that shared values and morals is important to keep a society united. The technology-focused societies came next because innovation, I think, is important. But I don't think technology alone should guide a society. In the last two places, I put the primitives utopia and the moral commonwealth. Because they seem less practical than the others and they'd be harder to actually maintain in the real world.
